title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #25 (동심원 4구역·매끈 / 가로 띠 4구역·물결 / 세로 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Italian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, sultry, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 55% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 42%, 69% and 84% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform square-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, cool and composed, pure icy-white hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 25% of the way down her figure from the top, about 41% of the way down her figure from the top and about 57% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), wide gold-and-crimson bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: needle heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, demure and soft, cool ash-grey hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 31% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 50% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 65% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, with repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: platform stiletto corset-lace boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
